verdict.rationale: Fastmail exposes the documented open JMAP protocol. Evidence covers session discovery via /.well-known/jmap, batched methodCalls for query, fetch and send in one request, and EventSource/WebPush push. It also uses standard OAuth 2.0 or Bearer auth, and Fastmail documents API tokens and has an API documentation page at fastmail.com/dev. The 404 probes for OpenAPI and llms.txt do not contradict this, since JMAP is a distinct protocol and not an OpenAPI-described REST API. Missing for 10: Fastmail-specific API docs and token pages appear only as titles with no content detail, there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of driving Fastmail via JMAP, and there is no machine-readable spec or llms.txt for agent consumption.
